question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：乌拉圭 vs 佛得角（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Uruguay vs Cabo Verde (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
one_liner_cn: 乌拉圭实力与阵容厚度全面占优，常规时间取胜约68%，但佛得角是组织性强的世界杯新军，平局加冷门仍有约三分之一概率。
one_liner_en: Uruguay dominate on strength and depth (~68% to win in 90 minutes), but well-organized debutants Cabo Verde leave draw-plus-upset at roughly one-third probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距达 314 分（乌拉圭 1892 vs 佛得角 1578），Davidson 三路模型给出乌拉圭约 69% 的基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 314-point Elo gap (Uruguay 1892 vs Cabo Verde 1578) yields a ~69% baseline win probability for Uruguay in the Davidson three-way model.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭主力齐整：Valverde、Araújo、Ugarte 领衔 26 人名单，仅 Bentancur 因重伤存在出战疑问。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are near full strength: Valverde, Araujo and Ugarte headline the 26-man squad; only Bentancur is a fitness doubt after a serious injury.

key_reasons.cn: 佛得角史上首次参加世界杯，大赛经验空白，但球队组织性强、士气高昂，迈阿密湿热气候对其并非劣势。
key_reasons.en: Cabo Verde are first-time World Cup participants with no tournament pedigree but strong organization and morale; Miami's heat is no disadvantage for them.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 69.1/19.6/11.3; bounded evidence adjustment -1.1pp off Uruguay (Bentancur doubt, organized debutant opponent, heat-neutral venue), renormalized to 68/20/12. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin evidence. No betting/prediction-market data used.
